title: Paragon crests
wikitext:
{{redirect|Crest|Festival hat}} Art styles for [[Paragon headgear]] vary by attribute bonus independently of body armor art. They are the same for all armorers across a campaign, including [[prestige armor]] crafters. The exception is Vabbian Crests and the Obsidian Crest, which are currently the only types of prestige headgear for Paragons. All crafted headgear can be upgraded with an [[insignia]] and a [[rune]].
